scanMethod: Each SKU:36 views, azimuth0..330deg in30deg steps at elevations -60/0/60deg. Compare RGB with UNKNOWN PCB visible/hidden at800x800; detect added pixels outside each opaque baseline row extent (minimum channel<245;1px tolerance;difference>3). This scanline envelope supplements CAD clearance; it is not full silhouette or photo calibration.
interiorVisibility: Nonzero changed pixels are retained: the proxy can be seen through source CAD openings. It is not hidden or removed; no claim that all internal pixels are occluded. All changed pixels remain within the opaque assembly row envelope.
visualChecks: Gold shell retains independent connector and UNKNOWN materials
Purple translucent rear view retains internally bounded UNKNOWN proxy
